title: Jutsu Upkeep
body:
Syntax: help jutsu upkeep

Description: Active Sharingan, Sage Mode, Shadow Clones, Track, Kamui Pocket Dimension, and Samurai Sabre pay their normal resource costs at each upkeep tick. Their Chakra and Stamina costs are combined into one report every six minutes, with each ability listed separately. Turning off an ability or running out of resources reports its pending cost immediately. Learned jutsu with paid maintenance, plus active Chisei, Hidden Mist, Chokkan and general ninja toggles, have a chance to gain 1% proficiency every ten active seconds even outside combat. The chance is (100 - current proficiency)%, capped at 100%; each gain awards 10 character XP and a message. Off or expired effects do not train, and toggling repeatedly cannot produce extra maintenance rolls. Sharingan uses its own bloodline mastery progression, while Sage Mode mastery comes from training with its elder.

Date: 2026-09-27
